title: Get details of a popular hashtag
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get detailed information about a popular hashtag, such as audience insights and hashtag status. If the returned `hashtag_status` is ONLINE, you can use the [/adgroup/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739499616346114) endpoint and pass the returned `hashtag_id` to the `action_category_ids` field. This will set the hashtag as a targeting action category for the ad group. You can also discover similar hashtags by using the [/tool/hashtag/recommend/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1736271339521025) endpoint. Pass the returned `hashtag_name` to the `keywords` field to get similar hashtags. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/discovery/detail/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.

Pass one of the advertiser IDs returned via `advertiser_ids` from [/oauth2/access_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |discovery_type {Required}|string|The type of discovery item.

Currently, we only support `HASHTAG`.| |hashtag_id {Required}|string|Hashtag ID.

Pass in a hashtag ID that is returned via the [/discovery/trending_list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825119032526849) endpoint.
If the hashtag you provide isn't included in the list returned by the `/discovery/trending_list/` endpoint, you will receive an empty list in response.

Example: `4268426520694`.| |country_code {Required}|string|Location code.

Specify the same `country_code` as the one you input in the `/discovery/trending_list/` endpoint.
If the `country_code` you provide is not associated with the hashtag, we will return an error.

See [Location code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010) for the supported values.

Example: `DE`.| |date_range {Required}|string|The timeframe in which the items have been popular.

Specify the same `date_range` as the one you input in the `/discovery/trending_list/` endpoint.
If the `date_range` you provide is not associated with the hashtag, we will return an error.

Enum values:
  • `1DAY`: last 1 day.
  • `7DAY`: last 7 days.
  • `30DAY`: last 30 days.
  • `120DAY`: last 120 days.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/discovery/detail/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&discovery_type=HASHTAG&hashtag_id={{hashtag_id}}&country_code=US&date_range=7DAY' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|hashtag_id|string|Hashtag ID.

Example: `4268426520694`.| #|hashtag_name|string|Hashtag name.

Example: `yummy`.| #|views|integer|The number of views for related videos that feature this hashtag in the selected region and timeframe.

Example: 134333716.| #|views_global_lifetime|integer|The number of views for related videos that feature this hashtag, globally and across their whole lifetime.

Example: 91639649280.| #|posts|integer|The number of posts for related videos that feature this hashtag in the selected region and timeframe.

Example: 21856.| #|posts_global_lifetime|integer|The number of posts for related videos that feature this hashtag, globally and across their whole lifetime.

Example: 7846729.| #|top_country_list|string[]|The location codes of the top five locations in the world where this hashtag is most popular.

To learn about the location that a location code represents, see [Location code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010).

Example: `["US", "GB", "PH", "CA", "DE"]`.| #|hashtag_status|string|The status of the hashtag.

Enum values:
  • `ONLINE`: available for ad creation.
  • `OFFLINE`: unavailable for ad creation.
| #|trending_history|object[]|The historical ranking data for the hashtag, spanning up to the past 30 days.| ##|date|string|Date, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Example: `2024-01-01`.| ##|rank_position_daily|string|The rank position of the hashtag among hashtags across all categories or industries in the selected region (`country_code`) on the date.

Example: `73`.

Note: If the hashtag does not perform well compared to the last time period, the hashtag will not be considered a trending hashtag and the value of this field will be null.| ##|views_daily|integer|The number of views for related videos that feature this hashtag in the selected region (`country_code`) on the date.

Example: 39409290.

Note: If the daily views are less than 1,000, the value of this field will be null.| #|audience_insights|object|Information about viewers that watch videos associated with this hashtag.

Note: If `hashtag_status` is `OFFLINE` or the expected audience size for the hashtag is less than 1,000, `audience_insights` will be returned as empty.| ##|audience_ages|object[]|Information about viewers' age.| ###|age|string|Age group.

Enum values:`18-24`,`25-34`,`35+`.| ###|percentage|number|The approximate percentage of viewers associated with different age groups.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "hashtag_status": "ONLINE", "posts": 31927, "hashtag_id": "{{hashtag_id}}", "audience_insights": { "audience_ages": [ { "percentage": 0.36926615840545485, "age": "25-34" }, { "percentage": 0.3550167061571056, "age": "18-24" }, { "percentage": 0.2757171047811277, "age": "35+" } ] }, "hashtag_name": "tattoo", "views_global_lifetime": 157770993216, "posts_global_lifetime": 12543346, "views": 216408760, "top_country_list": [ "US", "MX", "BR", "VN", "ID" ], "trending_history": [ { "date": "2024-03-09", "rank_position_daily": "121", "views_daily": 39181186 }, ... { "date": "2024-04-06", "rank_position_daily": "85", "views_daily": 49419265 }, { "date": "2024-04-07", "rank_position_daily": "128", "views_daily": 45524768 } ] } } (/code) ```
